verdict.rationale: Vapi docs explicitly describe multilingual support with automatic language detection and native voice quality (vapi-docs-58), directly matching the story's core ask. However, there's no detail or evidence on mid-call language switching specifics, no independent/hands-on corroboration of the multilingual detection working in practice, and no example configuration walkthrough. Missing for 10: hands-on/community validation of language switching mid-call, detailed docs on how switching triggers/behaves, and supported language list.
